answer: Farming becomes an orchard bet on surviving 120 epochs of grading, and every violet settlement recomputes the trellis schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 120 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
